mapper.insert: insert ignore into t_train_seat_occupancy (train_id, service_date, seat_id, occupy_bitmap, version, create_time, update_time, del_flag) select train_id, #{serviceDate}, id, 0, 0, now(), now(), 0 from t_seat where train_id = #{trainId}
mapper.select: select s.id, s.train_id, s.carriage_number, s.seat_number, s.seat_type, s.price, o.occupy_bitmap, o.version, s.seat_layout_code, s.seat_feature_mask from t_seat s inner join t_train_seat_occupancy o on o.train_id = s.train_id and o.seat_id = s.id and o.service_date = #{serviceDate} and o.del_flag = 0 where s.train_id = #{trainId} and s.carriage_number = #{carriageNumber} and s.seat_type = #{seatType} and (o.occupy_bitmap & #{requestMask}) = 0 order by s.seat_number asc limit #{limit}

select s.carriage_number as carriageNumber, count(*) as seatCount from t_seat s inner join t_train_seat_occupancy o on o.train_id = s.train_id and o.seat_id = s.id and o.service_date = #{serviceDate} and o.del_flag = 0 where s.train_id = #{trainId} and s.seat_type = #{seatType} and (o.occupy_bitmap & #{requestMask}) = 0 group by s.carriage_number having seatCount > 0
